deals.desc: Rubio's everyday value menu features meals from $7 to $10, including the Fish and Chips for $7.99.

deals.deal: Fire-Grilled Combos from $5.99: Pollo Bowl, Chicken Burrito or 3 Tacos al Carbon with Chips and a Drink

The chain advertised them at $5 through 2022; prices vary by market.

deals.deal: Sub of the Week: $2 Off This Week's Featured Whole Sub
deals.desc: Every week Publix takes $2 off one featured whole deli sub (a Boar's Head turkey sub or the Publix Deli Ultimate Sub, for example, about $8.99 instead of $10.99), fully customizable at the counter, online or in the app. The featured sub changes with the weekly ad; the deli's weekly specials page lists it.

deals.deal: $9.99 Pita Meal Deal

deals.deal: BOGO 50% Off Footlongs with Code BOGO50
deals.desc: Buy one footlong online or in the Subway app and get a second 50% off with code BOGO50 at participating locations. Listed by The Krazy Coupon Lady on October 2, 2026; the code has run since summer and may end without notice, so enter it before paying.

deals.deal: $2 Off Orders of $10 or More
deals.desc: Announced by email on 2026-10-20: get $2 off any Potbelly order of $10 or more, valid online and in-store for 14 days.

deals.deal: $5 Off Delivery Orders of $25 or More
deals.desc: Announced by email on 2026-10-20: use code SCORE for $5 off a $25+ delivery order of stir-fry or salads placed on the honeygrow app or site.

deals.deal: $25 Off Catering Orders of $200 or More
deals.desc: Announced by email on 2026-10-20: take $25 off any TMAD catering order of $200 or more before tax.

deals.deal: Sushi Wednesday: Select Oumi Rolls for $6
deals.desc: Every Wednesday in most Sprouts Farmers Market locations, select Oumi sushi rolls from the in-store sushi case are $6 each instead of the regular $8 to $10 (verified in store October 2026; the chain's older FAQ still says $5). Walk in and grab them: no coupon, app, or membership needed; participation and selection vary by store.

deals.deal: Sushi Wednesday: Snowfox Promo Rolls for $6
deals.desc: Every Wednesday, Kroger-family stores with a Snowfox sushi counter (Kroger, Fry's, King Soopers and other banners) sell the Wednesday Only promo lineup, including spicy tuna, Philly, California and veggie rolls, for $6 a roll (up from $5 in 2025) versus $8 to $10 the rest of the week. Walk in; a free Kroger Plus card may be needed for the promo price.

deals.deal: $5 Sushi Wednesday: Select Fresh Rolls for $5
deals.desc: Every Wednesday at Publix stores with a sushi counter, select fresh-made rolls (spicy tuna, California, spicy shrimp, cream cheese/Philadelphia-style, vegetable and more; selection varies by store) are $5 each instead of the usual $6 to $10. Walk in and grab them from the sushi case: no app, coupon, or membership needed, while supplies last.

deals.deal: Sushi Wednesday: Select Nori Sushi Rolls for $6

deals.deal: Sushi Wednesday: Select Sushiya Rolls for $7
deals.desc: Every Wednesday, H-E-B stores with an in-store Sushiya counter sell select fresh rolls for $7 (regularly about $9 to $12). No coupon or app needed; selection varies by store and sells out by evening.

deals.deal: $5.99 Sushi Wednesday: Select Rolls
deals.desc: Every Wednesday, participating ShopRite stores sell select fresh sushi rolls (spicy crab, California and more) for $5.99, regularly $8 to $10. In-store only; ShopRite stores are independently owned, so selection and participation vary.
